purpose: familywise validation-sample certification with replicate-specific cluster bootstrap-t studentization

version_boundary.v1_role: historical fixed-SE standardized max-deviation provenance; frozen receipts remain unchanged

estimator.group_gain: sum block weighted gain numerators divided by sum block weight masses
estimator.point_studentizer: cluster ratio influence standard error using N_b - theta_hat W_b
estimator.bootstrap_studentizer: recomputed from the resampled block multiset inside every bootstrap replicate

simultaneous_family.primary_statistic: maximum absolute replicate-specific bootstrap-t statistic across every estimable validation group
simultaneous_family.critical_value: requested conservative empirical quantile of the per-replicate maximum
simultaneous_family.final_interval: theta_hat plus/minus critical_value times original-sample cluster ratio standard error
simultaneous_family.zero_se_moved_draw: t equals infinity and interval fails closed

scientific_assumptions.independent_group_route: validation-group sampling domains are defensibly independent
scientific_assumptions.within_group_blocks: caller-declared validation blocks are exchangeable sampling units
scientific_assumptions.shared_cross_group_blocks: use the separate paired shared-block route instead of this independent-group route
scientific_assumptions.upstream_predictions: held-out predictive scores are treated as supplied and fixed

calibration.ci_role: regression guardrail, not a publication-grade Monte Carlo confidence interval
